Aggregate series to a lower frequency

Source: R/aggregate_series.R
aggregate_series.Rd

Summarise daily, weekly, or monthly series into calendar months, quarters, or years, such as the last daily close of each month or the quarterly sum of a monthly flow.

Usage

aggregate_series(
  data,
  date_col = "date",
  value_col = "value",
  group_cols = NULL,
  period = c("month", "quarter", "year"),
  summary = c("last", "first", "mean", "sum", "max", "min"),
  na_rm = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A non-empty data.frame, tibble, or data.table.

date_col

Name of the Date column. Defaults to "date".

value_col

Non-empty character vector naming numeric value columns. Each column is aggregated with the same summary.

group_cols

Optional character vector naming grouping columns. Each group is aggregated separately. Grouping columns must differ from date_col and value_col.

period

Target calendar period: "month", "quarter", or "year".

summary

Statistic computed within each period: "last", "first", "mean", "sum", "max", or "min". Use "last" or "mean" for stocks and prices, and "sum" for flows.

na_rm

Whether to drop missing values before summarising. With the default FALSE, "mean", "sum", "max", and "min" return NA for a period containing a missing value, while "first" and "last" return the value on the first or last dated row, which may be missing. With TRUE, they use the first or last observed value. A period with no observed values returns NA in either case.

Value

A tibble with one row per group and observed period, holding the grouping columns, the date column, and the aggregated value columns as doubles. Other columns are dropped. Rows are sorted by group and date.

Details

Each period is dated by its first day, so January 2024 is dated 2024-01-01 whatever the dates of the underlying observations. Only periods with at least one observation are returned.

Periods at the start and end of a series may be partly observed, and their sums and means then cover fewer observations than complete periods. With summary = "last", the value is the last observation in the period, which for trading data may fall before the last calendar day. A weekly observation is assigned whole to the period containing its date, so a week that straddles a month end is not split.

Grouping comes only from group_cols. A grouped tibble or a keyed tsibble needs its grouping variables passed there. A warning flags calls in which no period holds more than one observation, which happens when period is not coarser than the data.

See also

interpolate_series() to fill missing values before aggregating, and augment_rolling() for rolling and year-to-date aggregations at the original frequency.

Examples

# Quarterly sum of monthly vehicle production
vehicles |>
  aggregate_series(
    value_col = "production",
    period = "quarter",
    summary = "sum"
  )
#> # A tibble: 180 × 2
#>    date       production
#>    <date>          <dbl>
#>  1 1981-01-01     129316
#>  2 1981-04-01     193279
#>  3 1981-07-01     189523
#>  4 1981-10-01     193279
#>  5 1982-01-01     202631
#>  6 1982-04-01     201488
#>  7 1982-07-01     218435
#>  8 1982-10-01     243882
#>  9 1983-01-01     219661
#> 10 1983-04-01     231464
#> # ℹ 170 more rows

# Annual average of each retail series
retail_volume |>
  aggregate_series(
    group_cols = "name_series",
    period = "year",
    summary = "mean"
  )
#> # A tibble: 351 × 3
#>    name_series                                  date       value
#>    <chr>                                        <date>     <dbl>
#>  1 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1988-01-01  455.
#>  2 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1989-01-01  468.
#>  3 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1990-01-01  475.
#>  4 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1991-01-01  435.
#>  5 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1992-01-01  416.
#>  6 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1993-01-01  400.
#>  7 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1994-01-01  389.
#>  8 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1995-01-01  380.
#>  9 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1996-01-01  367.
#> 10 alcoholic-drinks-other-beverages-and-tobacco 1997-01-01  365 
#> # ℹ 341 more rows
